summary: Preserve complete whole-subject schedule discovery and mirror semantics across Printing Press regeneration.
required_behavior: Whole-subject searches discover catalogs from the official LACCD schedule API before PeopleSoft fan-out.
Normalize, deduplicate, sort, and explicitly bound discovered catalogs; positive --max-courses selects the first N and --max-courses 0 is unbounded.
Never request, parse, or merge the collapsed no-catalog PeopleSoft sample for whole-subject results.
Perform one catalog-scoped PeopleSoft request per selected catalog, deduplicate class numbers, and abort the whole scope on discovery or catalog failure.

Persist only version-2 complete whole-subject mirrors; retain discovery_source=laccd-schedule-api as provenance, while validity requires a non-null valid ordered catalogs array, equal total/scanned counts, truncated=false, and a sync timestamp.
Keep legacy mirrors available for explicit catalog reads while requiring a resync for whole-subject local or auto reads.
Preserve the direct-catalog degraded path without claiming whole-subject completeness.
Keep deterministic fixture replay separate from current live production evidence.
preservation_notes: The generated false assumption was that a collapsed no-catalog PeopleSoft sample enumerates every course and section.
The local incident record is docs/incidents/2026-08-25-whole-subject-schedule-completeness.md; its captured fixtures are historical deterministic evidence, not live schedule proof.
